title: Counting subsets of bounded size
statement: Let $s$ be a finite set and let $k$ be a natural number. The number of subsets of $s$ having at most $k$ elements is at most $(|s|+1)^k$.
replaced: For any finite set $s$ and $k\in\mathbb N$, the number of subsets $t\subseteq s$ with $|t|\le k$ is at most $(|s|+1)^k$.
